g.text: Gene strand, cased for the placement named by the gold-standard script (▲): lowercase

text.style: font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #404040

g.text: grey, exon; uppercase, intron. Shaded: bases found at both ends, across which the

text.style: font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #404040

g.text: intron can be moved without changing the spliced sequence. Rows aligned on the

text.style: font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #404040

g.text: codons of the placement on an AG acceptor (phase 1, blue), light lines between codons;

text.style: font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #404040

g.text: exon flanks trimmed to whole codons. Letters: amino acids under the middle base of

text.style: font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #404040

g.text: each codon of that placement (the codon split by the intron on the side holding two of

text.style: font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #404040

g.text: its bases), one line under the rows that translate alike. Right: dinucleotides of each

text.style: font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #404040

g.text: placement, from left to right. Rows in italics: test assemblies (other individuals of the

text.style: font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #404040

g.text: same species), exons carried from the gold standard.
